mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a current temperature of 60 degrees and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

The City of Verona has released engineering reports for ongoing projects, and residents are invited to participate in the upcoming US 18/151 Corridor Study public meetings, with an in-person session on November 18 and a virtual option on November 19 to discuss initial design concepts.

We have plenty of activity in the community, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia all taking place today, followed by live music and the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly safety report, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding prohibited eMotos, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
